mapper.select: SELECT LIFE_ID AS lifeId, STORY AS story, SOURCE_IDS AS sourceIds, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT + 9 / 24, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt /* DB 시계가 UTC 라 한국 시간으로 +9시간 (11/25) */ FROM AI_STORY WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_STORY (LIFE_ID, STORY, SOURCE_IDS) VALUES (#{lifeId}, #{story, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{sourceIds, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT h.EVENT_ID AS eventId, h.TITLE AS title, h.START_YEAR AS startYear, h.END_YEAR AS endYear, h.DESCRIPTION AS description, CASE WHEN h.EVENT_ID IN (SELECT g.HIST_EVENT_ID FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG e JOIN GAME_EVENT g ON g.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID WHERE e.LIFE_ID = l.LIFE_ID AND g.HIST_EVENT_ID IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS experienced, s.SOURCE_ID AS sourceId, s.TITLE AS sourceTitle, s.URL AS sourceUrl FROM LIFE l JOIN HISTORY_EVENT h ON h.COUNTRY_CODE IN (l.BIRTH_COUNTRY, l.CURRENT_COUNTRY) LEFT JOIN DATA_SOURCE s ON s.SOURCE_ID = h.SOURCE_ID WHERE l.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND h.START_YEAR <= l.BIRTH_YEAR + NVL(l.DEATH_AGE, l.CURRENT_AGE) AND h.END_YEAR >= l.BIRTH_YEAR ORDER BY experienced DESC, h.START_YEAR

SELECT c.DECADE AS decade, c.LIFE_EXPECTANCY AS lifeExpectancy, c.GDP_PER_CAPITA AS gdpPerCapita, c.URBAN_RATE AS urbanRate, c.TFR AS tfr, c.IS_ESTIMATED AS isEstimated, s.SOURCE_ID AS sourceId, s.TITLE AS sourceTitle, s.URL AS sourceUrl FROM LIFE l JOIN COUNTRY_STAT c ON c.COUNTRY_CODE = l.BIRTH_COUNTRY LEFT JOIN DATA_SOURCE s ON s.SOURCE_ID = c.SOURCE_ID WHERE l.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND c.DECADE BETWEEN TRUNC(l.BIRTH_YEAR / 10) * 10 AND TRUNC((l.BIRTH_YEAR + NVL(l.DEATH_AGE, l.CURRENT_AGE)) / 10) * 10 ORDER BY c.DECADE
